explorer:bitcoinxor.fee: 1% own-template DATUM; 2% pool-built-template endpoint (homepage checked September 16, 2026).
explorer:bitcoinxor.payout: Shared TIDES-style rewards paid directly through coinbase; legacy solo service also listed.
explorer:bitcoinxor.protocols: DATUM and a pooled Stratum endpoint; legacy Stratum V1 solo is described as being wound down.
explorer:bitcoinxor.template: Own node and gateway for DATUM; pool creates templates on its pooled Stratum endpoint.
explorer:bitcoinxor.researchNotes: Fee rechecked September 16, 2026: homepage now lists 2% for the pool-built-template endpoint, replacing our older 5% snapshot. The website says historical gateway fees blend through the TIDES work window; individual block fee outputs may not equal the current advertised rate. Other profile fields retain their original review date.

research:omegapool.name: OmegaPool
research:omegapool.fee: 0% own gateway; 10% on public-gateway work. 75% of that charge is redistributed to own-gateway miners; 25% stays with the pool.
research:omegapool.payout: Website states proportional work-window payouts directly in coinbase, with an 8x network-difficulty window. Public-gateway charges and redistribution affect the split.
research:omegapool.minimum: 0.00000546 (546 sats per split; below-threshold work stays in the window for a later block).
research:omegapool.protocols: DATUM: pool.iohzrd.tech:28915 (gateway connections). Public Stratum V1: gateway.iohzrd.tech:23334 (BLAKE2b hardware).
research:omegapool.template: Own node and DATUM gateway: operator claims miner-selected templates. Public gateway: operator selects transactions. Neither path has been independently assessed by XBT Pulse.
research:omegapool.researchNotes: Public website snapshot, not an operator submission or telemetry approval. Advertises RATUM Prime 0.1.38. Public gateway refuses new connections above its configured 10% network-share threshold; existing miners continue, so this is not a hard pool-size cap. No block attribution has been linked to this researched profile.

explorer:convoy.fee: 1% own-node DATUM gateway; 2% direct Stratum failover service.
explorer:convoy.protocols: DATUM: datum-beta1.mine.convoy.xyz:28915. Stratum V1 failover: mine.convoy.xyz:3333.
explorer:convoy.template: Setup guide states that the miner runs a synced node and DATUM gateway to generate templates. Direct Stratum failover gives up that template control.
explorer:convoy.researchNotes: Dated public setup-guide claims, not operator-confirmed telemetry or an assessment. The public Stratum endpoint is advertised as failover, not the primary connection. Payout method, minimum and withdrawal terms were not established in this review and remain unfilled.

explorer:riptide.fee: 0% DATUM; variable public SV1 fee advertised as currently 1%. Half of the SV1 skim is credited to live DATUM miners and half to operations.
explorer:riptide.payout: Website describes share-difficulty-weighted Ocean TIDES payouts, with a window of seven confirmed finds plus current work. It distinguishes coinbase payouts and manual payouts.
explorer:riptide.protocols: Connection settings checked September 24, 2026: DATUM riptide.maveth.ca:29120 (default, minimum difficulty 1024), or :29121 (8192). Public Stratum V1 sv1.riptide.maveth.ca:29128 (default), or :29129 (8192). Other terms retain their September 17 review date.
explorer:riptide.template: Website asks DATUM miners to run their own BLAKE2b Knots node and gateway. Direct ASIC SV1 is a separate pool-hosted connection, not the miner's own DATUM gateway.
explorer:riptide.researchNotes: Dated advertised terms, not independently verified template control or a rating. SV1 fees are explicitly variable; confirm current terms before connecting. The stated fee was read from public page text, not a live fee API. Minimum payout, withdrawal fees and server regions remain unverified.
